# Local news site

> A hyperlocal news and community site. This is a hostname-neutral fallback
> file; the real, per-city version is generated at request time.

This file lives in a shared build output and is served on every city domain in
this network, so it cannot name a city, a domain or a set of city-specific
pages — the previous version named exactly one city and was served to all of
them. The per-city document is generated by the `serve-llms` edge function
(supabase/functions/serve-llms/index.ts) from that city's `city_config` row.
It takes effect once the hosting layer routes /llms.txt to that function for
each domain; until then, you are reading this.

Links below are relative on purpose: they resolve against whichever city's
domain served this file.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Local headlines, events and community updates.
- [Today](/today): The day's brief on one page.
- [Events](/events): Upcoming events compiled from local calendars and venue listings.
- [Incidents](/incidents): Current public-safety, weather, road and utility incidents, each naming its source of record.
- [Eats](/eats): Restaurants and dining.
- [Nightlife](/nightlife): Live music, bars and evening listings.
- [Jobs](/jobs): Local job listings.
- [Deals](/deals): Offers posted by area businesses.
- [Directory](/directory): Local businesses, shops and services.
- [About](/about): Who publishes this, how it works, and how to reach it.

## Notes

- Only the pages listed above are linked here. The incident archive
  (/incidents/archive) and the machine-readable data endpoints
  (/data/incidents.json, /data/incidents.csv, /data/dataset.json) are served by
  edge functions and exist only once the hosting rewrite described above is in
  place — which is the same condition under which this fallback file stops
  being served. Listing them here would advertise URLs that, by construction,
  do not resolve for anyone reading this file. The per-city document generated
  by serve-llms lists them.
- Long-form guides exist for some cities in this network and not others. The
  per-city file lists only the guides that actually exist for that city.
- llms.txt is a proposed convention (llmstxt.org), not a standard any crawler
  vendor has committed to reading. It is published here because it is cheap,
  not because its adoption is proven.
